WITH input_payload AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS phone_number,
    NULLIF($2::text, '')::bigint AS source_number_id,
    NULLIF($3::text, '') AS external_contact_id,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS whatsapp_name,
    NULLIF($5::text, '') AS service,
    NULLIF($6::text, '') AS city,
    NULLIF($7::text, '') AS requirement,
    COALESCE($8::boolean, FALSE) AS is_partial,
    NULLIF($9::text, '')::bigint AS conversation_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($10::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS qualification_context
),
latest_lead AS (
  SELECT
    l.id AS previous_lead_id,
    l.previous_lead_id AS previous_previous_lead_id,
    l.source_number_id AS previous_source_number_id,
    l.external_contact_id AS previous_external_contact_id,
    l.whatsapp_name AS previous_whatsapp_name,
    l.phone_number AS previous_phone_number,
    l.service AS previous_service,
    l.city AS previous_city,
    l.requirement AS previous_requirement,
    l.clickup_task_id AS previous_clickup_task_id,
    l.clickup_task_url AS previous_clickup_task_url,
    ls.code AS previous_lead_status_code,
    l.created_at AS previous_created_at
  FROM leads l
  JOIN lead_statuses ls ON ls.id = l.lead_status_id
  JOIN input_payload ip ON TRUE
  WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND l.phone_number = ip.phone_number
  ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ip.phone_number,
  ip.source_number_id,
  ip.external_contact_id,
  ip.whatsapp_name,
  ip.service,
  ip.city,
  ip.requirement,
  ip.is_partial,
  ip.conversation_id,
  ip.qualification_context,
  ll.previous_lead_id,
  ll.previous_source_number_id,
  ll.previous_external_contact_id,
  ll.previous_whatsapp_name,
  ll.previous_service,
  ll.previous_city,
  ll.previous_requirement,
  ll.previous_lead_status_code,
  ll.previous_created_at
FROM input_payload ip
LEFT JOIN latest_lead ll ON TRUE;

WITH created_lead AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (
    previous_lead_id,
    source_number_id,
    external_contact_id,
    whatsapp_name,
    phone_number,
    service,
    city,
    requirement,
    qualification_context,
    channel,
    lead_status_id,
    is_qualified,
    is_partial,
    qualified_at
  )
  SELECT
    NULLIF($1::text, '')::bigint,
    NULLIF($2::text, '')::bigint,
    NULLIF($3::text, ''),
    NULLIF($4::text, ''),
    $5::text,
    NULLIF($6::text, ''),
    NULLIF($7::text, ''),
    NULLIF($8::text, ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($14::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    'whatsapp',
    ls.id,
    $10::boolean,
    $11::boolean,
    CASE WHEN $10::boolean THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END
  FROM lead_statuses ls
  WHERE ls.code = $9::text
  RETURNING *
),
linked_conversation AS (
  UPDATE conversations c
  SET
    lead_id = cl.id,
    source_number_id = COALESCE(cl.source_number_id, c.source_number_id),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM created_lead cl
  WHERE NULLIF($13::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    AND c.id = NULLIF($13::text, '')::bigint
  RETURNING c.id
),
ensure_rotation AS (
  INSERT INTO assignment_rotations (
    rotation_key,
    next_seller_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    $12::text,
    s.id,
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM sellers s
  WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.is_active = TRUE
    AND NULLIF(s.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC
  LIMIT 1
  ON CONFLICT (rotation_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
target_rotation AS (
  SELECT
    ar.id,
    ar.rotation_key,
    ar.next_seller_id
  FROM assignment_rotations ar
  WHERE ar.rotation_key = $12::text
),
selected_seller AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.whatsapp_number,
    s.clickup_user_id,
    s.sort_order,
    tr.id AS rotation_id
  FROM target_rotation tr
  JOIN sellers s ON s.id = tr.next_seller_id
  WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND s.is_active = TRUE
    AND NULLIF(s.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.whatsapp_number,
    s.clickup_user_id,
    s.sort_order,
    tr.id AS rotation_id
  FROM target_rotation tr
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT *
    FROM sellers
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
      AND is_active = TRUE
      AND NULLIF(clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY sort_order ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) s ON TRUE
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sellers sx
    WHERE sx.id = tr.next_seller_id
      AND sx.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND sx.is_active = TRUE
      AND NULLIF(sx.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
  )
  LIMIT 1
),
next_candidate AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT s2.id
        FROM sellers s2
        JOIN selected_seller cur ON TRUE
        WHERE s2.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND s2.is_active = TRUE
          AND NULLIF(s2.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
          AND s2.sort_order > cur.sort_order
        ORDER BY s2.sort_order ASC
        LIMIT 1
      ),
      (
        SELECT s3.id
        FROM sellers s3
        WHERE s3.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND s3.is_active = TRUE
          AND NULLIF(s3.clickup_user_id, '') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY s3.sort_order ASC
        LIMIT 1
      )
    ) AS next_seller_id
),
updated_seller AS (
  UPDATE sellers s
  SET
    last_assigned_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM selected_seller ss
  WHERE s.id = ss.id
  RETURNING s.id, s.name, s.whatsapp_number, s.clickup_user_id
),
updated_rotation AS (
  UPDATE assignment_rotations ar
  SET
    last_seller_id = ss.id,
    next_seller_id = nc.next_seller_id,
    last_assigned_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM selected_seller ss, next_candidate nc
  WHERE ar.id = ss.rotation_id
  RETURNING ar.id, ar.rotation_key, ar.last_seller_id, ar.next_seller_id
),
updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    assigned_seller_id = ss.id,
    assigned_at = NOW(),
    lead_status_id = ls.id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM selected_seller ss
  JOIN lead_statuses ls ON ls.code = 'assigned'
  JOIN created_lead cl ON TRUE
  WHERE l.id = cl.id
  RETURNING l.id, l.assigned_seller_id, l.assigned_at
),
insert_assignment AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_assignments (
    lead_id,
    seller_id,
    assignment_type,
    assignment_result,
    reason,
    rotation_id
  )
  SELECT
    cl.id,
    ss.id,
    'automatic',
    'assigned',
    'round_robin',
    ss.rotation_id
  FROM created_lead cl
  JOIN selected_seller ss ON TRUE
  RETURNING *
),
insert_failure AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_assignments (
    lead_id,
    seller_id,
    assignment_type,
    assignment_result,
    reason,
    rotation_id
  )
  SELECT
    cl.id,
    NULL,
    'automatic',
    'failed',
    'no_notifiable_seller',
    tr.id
  FROM created_lead cl
  LEFT JOIN target_rotation tr ON TRUE
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM selected_seller
  )
  RETURNING *
),
applied_assignment AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    assigned_seller_id = ia.seller_id,
    assigned_at = COALESCE(l.assigned_at, NOW()),
    lead_status_id = ls.id,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM insert_assignment ia
  JOIN lead_statuses ls ON ls.code = 'assigned'
  WHERE l.id = ia.lead_id
  RETURNING l.id, l.assigned_seller_id, l.assigned_at
)
SELECT
  cl.id AS lead_id,
  cl.phone_number,
  cl.whatsapp_name,
  cl.service,
  cl.city,
  cl.requirement,
  COALESCE(aa.assigned_seller_id, ul.assigned_seller_id) AS assigned_seller_id,
  us.name AS seller_name,
  us.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  us.clickup_user_id,
  CASE WHEN us.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'failed' END AS assignment_result,
  ur.next_seller_id
FROM created_lead cl
LEFT JOIN applied_assignment aa ON aa.id = cl.id
LEFT JOIN updated_lead ul ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN updated_seller us ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN updated_rotation ur ON TRUE;

WITH latest_assignment AS (
  SELECT
    la.lead_id,
    la.seller_id,
    la.assignment_result
  FROM lead_assignments la
  WHERE la.lead_id = $1::bigint
  ORDER BY la.created_at DESC, la.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
updated_lead AS (
  UPDATE leads l
  SET
    assigned_seller_id = COALESCE(la.seller_id, l.assigned_seller_id),
    assigned_at = CASE
      WHEN la.seller_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(l.assigned_at, NOW())
      ELSE l.assigned_at
    END,
    lead_status_id = CASE
      WHEN la.seller_id IS NOT NULL THEN ls_assigned.id
      ELSE l.lead_status_id
    END,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM latest_assignment la
  LEFT JOIN lead_statuses ls_assigned ON ls_assigned.code = 'assigned'
  WHERE l.id = la.lead_id
  RETURNING
    l.id AS lead_id,
    l.phone_number,
    l.whatsapp_name,
    l.service,
    l.city,
    l.requirement,
    l.qualification_context,
    l.assigned_seller_id
)
SELECT
  ul.lead_id,
  ul.phone_number,
  ul.whatsapp_name,
  ul.service,
  ul.city,
  ul.requirement,
  ul.qualification_context,
  (
    SELECT c.id
    FROM conversations c
    WHERE c.lead_id = ul.lead_id
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS conversation_id,
  ul.assigned_seller_id,
  s.name AS seller_name,
  s.whatsapp_number AS seller_whatsapp_number,
  s.clickup_user_id,
  CASE WHEN ul.assigned_seller_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned' ELSE 'failed' END AS assignment_result
FROM updated_lead ul
LEFT JOIN sellers s ON s.id = ul.assigned_seller_id;
